notes: Several takeoffs open at once, and copy/paste layers between them.

features: Work on several takeoffs at once - File > New takeoff tab, then click a tab to switch
Copy whole layers between takeoffs: tick layers in the Layers tab, Copy to project, then Paste in the other takeoff
Copy a lasso selection between takeoffs with 'To project'
Pasted marks are rescaled to the target sheet size, and layers keep their names, colours and shapes across buildings
